name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation Sink with Faucet, Waterfall and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: Elevate your kitchen experience with the MultiSINK All-in-One Workstation an innovative, IAPMO-certified sink system featuring three functional levels for seamless prep, wash, and dry. Custom-fit accessories adapt to your workflow, while the integrated waterfall rinse is controlled via a convenient diverter for effortless switching between faucet and waterfall flow. A built-in spinning Glass Washer ensures spotless drinkware, and space-saving Drying Stations keep your counters clutter-free. The premium stainless steel faucet offers three functions, including Boost Blade for tough messes, aerated flow for everyday use, and spray rinse for quick cleanups. Includes upgraded chopping board, colander, roll-up grids, and modern strainer. Dual mount design supports top-mount or undermount installation.
